title: Ping a host
description: Four pings to a host or address to test reachability and latency.

title: IP configuration (full)
description: Adapters, IP, gateway, DNS and DHCP details.

title: Flush DNS cache
description: Clears the local DNS resolver cache.

title: Register DNS
description: Re-registers this computer name in DNS.

title: Release and renew IP (DHCP)
description: The connection drops for a few seconds.

title: Test a TCP port
description: Checks that a port on another machine accepts connections.

title: Listening ports and owners
description: TCP ports in listening state with the owning process.
body: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Sort-Object LocalPort | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,@{n="Process";e={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200

title: Active connections
body: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort,@{n="Process";e={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200

title: Firewall profiles
description: State of the Windows Firewall profiles.

title: Wi-Fi status and saved networks
description: Current Wi-Fi connection and known profiles.
body: netsh wlan show interfaces & netsh wlan show profiles

title: Reset Winsock and TCP/IP
description: Repairs a broken network stack. Needs a restart afterwards.
body: netsh winsock reset && netsh int ip reset

title: Proxy settings
body: netsh winhttp show proxy; Get-ItemProperty "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings" | Select-Object ProxyEnable,ProxyServer,AutoConfigURL | Format-List

title: System information
description: OS version, uptime, memory, hotfixes and network cards.

title: Top 15 processes by CPU
body: Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Id,ProcessName,@{n="CPU(s)";e={[math]::Round($_.CPU,1)}},@{n="Mem(MB)";e={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String

title: Top 15 processes by memory
body: Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Id,ProcessName,@{n="Mem(MB)";e={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB)}},@{n="CPU(s)";e={[math]::Round($_.CPU,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String

title: Disk space
description: Size and free space of every drive.

title: Largest folders on C:\
description: Top-level folders by size (can take a few minutes).
body: Get-ChildItem C:\ -Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $s=(Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum; [pscustomobject]@{Folder=$_.FullName;GB=[math]::Round($s/1GB,2)} } | Sort-Object GB -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String

title: Recent system errors
description: Last 20 errors and criticals from the System log.

title: Recent application errors
description: Last 20 errors from the Application log.

title: Failed sign-in attempts (last 24h)
body: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName="Security";Id=4625;StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-1)} -MaxEvents 30 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object TimeCreated,@{n="Message";e={($_.Message -split "`n")[0..3] -join " "}} | Format-Table -Wrap | Out-String -Width 220

title: Pending reboot check
description: Shows whether Windows is waiting for a restart.
body: $p=@(); if(Test-Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending"){$p+="Component servicing"}; if(Test-Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired"){$p+="Windows Update"}; if($p){"Reboot pending: "+($p -join ", ")}else{"No reboot pending"}

title: Installed updates (hotfixes)
body: Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending | Select-Object -First 25 HotFixID,Description,InstalledOn,InstalledBy | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String

title: Installed programs
body: Get-ItemProperty "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*","HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object DisplayName | Sort-Object DisplayName | Select-Object DisplayName,DisplayVersion,Publisher | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200

title: Startup programs
body: Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand | Select-Object Name,Command,Location,User | Format-Table -Wrap | Out-String -Width 220

title: Logged-on users
description: Who is signed in (console and remote).

title: Local administrators
description: Members of the local Administrators group.

title: Scheduled tasks that failed
description: Tasks whose last run result is not success.
body: Get-ScheduledTask | Get-ScheduledTaskInfo | Where-Object {$_.LastTaskResult -ne 0 -and $_.LastRunTime -gt (Get-Date).AddYears(-1)} | Select-Object TaskName,LastRunTime,LastTaskResult | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200

title: Disk health (SMART status)
description: Physical disk health reported by Windows.

title: Battery report
body: Get-CimInstance Win32_Battery | Select-Object Name,EstimatedChargeRemaining,BatteryStatus,DesignCapacity,FullChargeCapacity | Format-List; powercfg /batteryreport /output "$env:TEMP\battery.html" | Out-Null; "Report: $env:TEMP\battery.html"

title: Group policy refresh
description: gpupdate /force (may log off or ask for a restart).

title: DISM check and repair image
description: Checks the Windows component store and restores health.

title: Check disk (read-only)
description: chkdsk without fixing, on a drive letter.

title: Restart a service
description: Stops and starts a Windows service by its short name.

title: Stopped automatic services
description: Services set to Automatic that are not running.
body: Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.StartType -eq "Automatic" -and $_.Status -ne "Running"} | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Status | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200

title: Clear print queue and restart spooler
body: Stop-Service Spooler -Force; Remove-Item "$env:SystemRoot\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service Spooler; Get-Service Spooler | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String

title: Reset Windows Update components
description: Stops update services, renames caches and restarts them.
body: net stop wuauserv & net stop bits & net stop cryptsvc & ren %systemroot%\SoftwareDistribution SoftwareDistribution.old & ren %systemroot%\System32\catroot2 catroot2.old & net start cryptsvc & net start bits & net start wuauserv

title: Clear temporary files
description: Deletes the system and user temp folders (files in use are skipped).
body: $b=(Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP,"$env:SystemRoot\Temp" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum; Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\*","$env:SystemRoot\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "Freed about $([math]::Round($b/1MB)) MB"

title: Sync time with the domain/time server
Domain controller and secure channel
description: Checks the trust to the domain.

title: Defender status
description: Antivirus state, signature age and last scans.

title: Defender quick scan
description: Starts a quick scan in the background.

title: Restart in a few minutes
description: Restarts Windows after a delay with a message to the user.
body: shutdown /r /t {{seconds}} /c "The IT team will restart this computer"

title: Cancel pending shutdown
description: Cancels a scheduled restart or shutdown.

title: Memory and load
body: uptime; free -m; echo; ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -12

title: Available updates
body: (apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null || yum check-update 2>/dev/null || dnf check-update 2>/dev/null) | head -40

title: Restart in a few minutes
body: shutdown -r +{{minutes}} "The IT team will restart this computer"

title: Rename the computer (host name)
description: Changes the computer name. Takes effect after a restart (use the Restart command afterwards). On a computer joined to a domain, rename it from Active Directory instead, because this does not change the domain record.

title: Rename the computer (host name)
description: Changes the host name now and in /etc/hostname. Running programs may keep the old name until they restart.
body:
n='{{newname}}'
if ! echo "$n" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?$'; then echo 'Not changed: use letters, numbers and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.'; exit 1; fi
echo "Current name: $(hostname)"
if command -v hostnamectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then hostnamectl set-hostname "$n"; else echo "$n" > /etc/hostname; hostname "$n"; fi
if grep -q '^127.0.1.1' /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null; then sed -i "s/^127\.0\.1\.1.*/127.0.1.1 $n/" /etc/hosts; fi
echo "New name: $(hostname)"
